description: Source code for a USB Audio Class 2 (UAC2) sample implementation with explicit feedback handling, involving USB device setup, I2S audio streaming, and feedback control logic.

methods.name: uac2_terminal_update_cb
methods.description: Callback to handle terminal enable/disable events, triggers I2S drop when terminal is disabled.

methods.name: uac2_get_recv_buf
methods.description: Provides buffer for receiving USB audio data, allocates from memory slab.

methods.name: uac2_data_recv_cb
methods.description: Handles received USB audio data, writes to I2S, manages underrun errors.

methods.name: uac2_buf_release_cb
methods.description: Placeholder for buffer release callback, not used in this sample.

methods.name: uac2_feedback_cb
methods.description: Provides feedback value for synchronization, either hardcoded or calculated.

methods.name: uac2_sof
methods.description: Start-of-frame callback to manage feedback processing and trigger I2S start after delay.
